Food calories

How many calories in butter?

Butter: about 72 kcal per serving (1 tablespoon, 10 g). That serving has 0.1 g protein, 0 g carbs and 8 g fat, which works out to about 720 kcal per 100 g.

Calories and nutrition

Per serving (1 tablespoon, 10 g)Per 100 g
Calories72 kcal720 kcal
Protein0.1 g1 g
Carbohydrates0 g0 g
Fat8 g80 g

Why the number varies

Fat is the biggest lever here. How much oil, butter, cheese or frying fat goes in, and how generously a spoon or ladle is filled, can move the calories more than anything else. Two plates that look alike can differ a lot.

How to log it in Pofu

Pofu is our app. To log this food, take a photo of your plate: Pofu estimates the food and portion and shows a confidence score, so you can see how sure it is and correct it. You can also search by name or scan a barcode, then set the serving to match what you ate. Get Pofu on the App Store.
